description: This Swift source file defines structures and functions related to parsing and selecting configurations for a talk provider. It includes a data structure for representing provider configuration selections, and a set of static methods for interpreting raw dictionary data, resolving provider configurations, and handling timeouts.

classes.name: TalkProviderConfigSelection
classes.description: Defines a configuration selection for a talk provider, including provider name, configuration dictionary, and normalization flag.

methods.name: bridgeFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Converts a raw optional dictionary with String keys and Any values to a dictionary with String keys and AnyCodable values.

methods.name: selectProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects a provider configuration based on input talk data, with fallback options and normalization checks.

methods.name: resolvedPositiveInt
methods.description: Resolves an Int value from an AnyCodable, with fallback if invalid; supports timeout and similar parameters.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the silence timeout in milliseconds from the talk configuration, with a fallback value.

methods.name: normalizedTalkProviderID
methods.description: Normalizes a provider ID string by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolvedProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves a provider configuration selection from the talk dictionary if available.
